{
  "data_as_of": "2026-09-15",
  "metrics": [
    {
      "name": "available_stock",
      "label": "Available stock",
      "status": "certified",
      "version": 3,
      "owner": "supply_chain_ops",
      "description": "Base units a store can sell or transfer: on hand in batches with at least 90 days to expiry (DR-001), minus stock it has shipped to other stores that has not arrived yet (in transit; cancelled transfers are not subtracted, DR-003). A stock position at the snapshot date.",
      "replaced_by": null
    },
    {
      "name": "days_of_cover",
      "label": "Days of cover",
      "status": "certified",
      "version": 1,
      "owner": "supply_chain_ops",
      "description": "How many days available stock lasts at the recent pace: available stock at the snapshot divided by average daily base units sold over the 28 full days before it.",
      "replaced_by": null
    },
    {
      "name": "gross_margin",
      "label": "Gross margin",
      "status": "certified",
      "version": 1,
      "owner": "finance",
      "description": "Net revenue minus the cost of goods sold at each store's weighted average cost for the SKU (DR-008). Returned goods are destroyed, so their cost is not reversed.",
      "replaced_by": null
    },
    {
      "name": "near_expiry_value",
      "label": "Near-expiry stock value",
      "status": "certified",
      "version": 1,
      "owner": "supply_chain_ops",
      "description": "Cost value (VND, VAT excluded) of stock in batches with fewer than 90 days to expiry, including expired stock not yet written off.",
      "replaced_by": null
    },
    {
      "name": "net_revenue",
      "label": "Net revenue",
      "status": "certified",
      "version": 2,
      "owner": "finance",
      "description": "Sales after discounts and before VAT, counted on the sale date, minus refunds before VAT, counted on the return date (DR-002, DR-006). A return in August of a July sale lowers August.",
      "replaced_by": null
    },
    {
      "name": "revenue_v1",
      "label": "Revenue (v1, deprecated)",
      "status": "deprecated",
      "version": 1,
      "owner": "finance",
      "description": "The old revenue number: what customers paid, VAT included, by sale date, with returns ignored. Kept so old questions get a pointer to net_revenue instead of a silent wrong answer.",
      "replaced_by": "net_revenue"
    },
    {
      "name": "sell_through_rate",
      "label": "Sell-through rate",
      "status": "certified",
      "version": 2,
      "owner": "supply_chain_ops",
      "description": "Base units sold divided by base units received net in the same period: received from suppliers and other stores, minus units transferred out. Returned units are not subtracted from sales. No value when net received is zero or negative (DR-011).",
      "replaced_by": null
    }
  ]
}

{
  "name": "sell_through_rate",
  "label": "Sell-through rate",
  "description": "Base units sold divided by base units received net in the same period: received from suppliers and other stores, minus units transferred out. Returned units are not subtracted from sales. No value when net received is zero or negative (DR-011).",
  "status": "certified",
  "version": 2,
  "owner": "supply_chain_ops",
  "owner_team": "@your-org/supply-chain-ops",
  "certified_on": "2026-10-26",
  "recertify_by": "2027-04-24",
  "agent_notes": "A ratio, not a percentage. Only meaningful over a period of weeks or more; for one day it swings with delivery days. No value means the store took in no stock overall: say so, never report 0. A new_store caveat means a store's opening stock is in the period but its sales are not; do not compare it with established stores.",
  "decision": {
    "id": "DR-011",
    "title": "Sell-through has no value when net received is not positive, and new stores are flagged",
    "decision": "`sell_through_rate` keeps DR-009's formula: base units sold (gross of\nreturns) / (base units received from suppliers and other stores - base\nunits transferred out), all in the same period\n(`dbt/models/semantic/metrics_supply_chain.yml`). Two rules are added:\n\n1. **No value when net received is zero or negative.** The ratio is\n   returned empty, never 0 and never negative. An answer says the store\n   took in no stock overall in the period.\n2. **New stores are flagged.** A store in scope that opened after the\n   period began, and no more than 7 days after it ended, adds the caveat\n   `new_store:<store>`. The chain delivers opening stock in the week\n   before a store opens, so that stock counts as received while the\n   store's sales cover only part of the period, or none of it."
  },
  "golden_questions": 5,
  "caveats": [
    "pos_sync_lag:<store>: the store's POS data does not cover the whole period yet (DR-004)",
    "new_store:<store>: the store opened during or just after the period (DR-011)"
  ],
  "replaced_by": null
}
